name: lens-flare
title: Lens Flare
description: A camera lens flare: a bright star burst and a faint rainbow halo that slowly shimmer on the dark ground. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT) on the brand ground; the flare keeps its optical colours (white star, rainbow halo) – only the ground is a variable. Fades in and out on cues, holds 30 s.
